sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Seasonal change: this quest cannot be obtained.

Professional Fitness - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Ready to keep going? Of course it's not over, what else did you expect? We're not messing around here, I take this seriously. So, you've smelled gunpowder, now you need to prove to me that you can kill. A lot. And, preferably, make it look good. So, you ready? Alright, I'll be keeping an eye on you in the Arena."

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +2,400 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.01
- 15 GP coins
  - 16 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 17 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Lega Medal
"You did well, took them down like puppies! I think you've got potential."
